item.blurb: Hone Raises $60M Seed. Hone raises a $60 million seed round led by Benchmark and Index Ventures to develop autonomous AI agents for business operations at a $285 million valuation.
Alo Hakeem Raises $165,000 Pre-seed. Alo Hakeem raises $165,000 in pre-seed funding led by Ebla Ventures to expand its home healthcare platform and infrastructure across Syria.
Orca Fraud Raises $2.35M Seed. Orca Fraud raises $2.35M in seed funding led by Norrsken22 to expand its real-time fraud intelligence platform across emerging global markets.
Pave Finance Raises $5M Series A Extension. Pave Finance raises $5 million in a Series A extension to grow its engineering and market-facing teams for its AI portfolio management platform.
Voltus Raises $225M Series D. Voltus raises $225M in a Series D round led by Generation Investment Management, Activate Capital, and Vitol to scale its distributed energy platform.
Manus Raises $500M at $4B Valuation. Manus raises over $500M in a new funding round co-led by Boyu Capital and IDG Capital to expand its autonomous AI agent platform and workforce solutions.
